correctness.rationale: For 14 vertices and 21 edges, switching normalizes 13 spanning-tree edge signs and leaves exactly eight free chord signs. All 256 signatures and all 8192 root-fixed spin cuts are enumerated exactly; an independent even-cycle-space Krawtchouk transform reconstructs every cut histogram. The moment identities are proved by the even-degree subgraph expansion and verified for all signatures. The complete table contains two identical moment-6 values 126021 with different frustration indices 2 and 3, while the pair of moments 6 and 8 distinguishes every full DOS type. No incomplete enumeration or numerical extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Motivated by the recent spectral-feature approach to zero-field signed-Ising frustration, the all-signings Heawood benchmark answers the precise minimum moment degree needed for deterministic identification, and exhibits a sharp pair of equal low-order moments with distinct ground energies. The eighth order also recovers the entire density of states for this natural cubic girth-six incidence graph. The result is not claimed to extend to larger graphs or to provide downstream physical efficiency gains.
